exercises.title: Inspection 3 — entry and exit criteria
exercises.problemHtml:
Entry criteria say when a document is ready to be inspected (e.g. it follows the template, it was spell-checked, the author has fixed obvious problems, line numbers are printed, open issues are marked TBD, reference documents are available). Exit criteria say when the inspection is finished (e.g. all issues are resolved, changes are verified, the document is checked in under configuration control).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Tiêu chí vào: khi nào tài liệu sẵn sàng để inspection. Tiêu chí ra: khi nào inspection kết thúc.

1. The draft is full of spelling errors and half the sections are empty. The moderator should…Bản nháp đầy lỗi chính tả, nửa số mục trống. Moderator nên…

   Answer: b) All issues raised are resolved and the changes are verified

   Answer: c) So issues can be located precisely in the meeting and the log
   Precise references speed up the meeting and rework.VI: Tham chiếu chính xác giúp họp và sửa nhanh.

exercises.title: Inspection 4 — automate part of the checklist
exercises.problemHtml:
An inspection checklist has items a tool can pre-check, so inspectors spend their time on real thinking. Write function lint(text) that returns an array of issue codes (any order, no duplicates) for one requirement:

  • NO_SHALL — the text does not contain the word "shall".
  • MULTI — "shall" appears more than once.
  • VAGUE — contains (whole word, case-insensitive) one of: fast, user-friendly, easy, flexible, efficient, robust, appropriate, adequate, several, etc, and/or, support.
  • PASSIVE — "shall be" followed by a word ending in "ed" or "en" (e.g. "shall be sent", "shall be displayed").
  • TBD — contains "TBD" (upper case).

A clean requirement returns []. It is tested on hidden requirements.

Requirements

  • Whole-word matching: "supported" must not trigger "support"; "etc." triggers "etc".
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết lint(text) trả mảng mã lỗi (không trùng) cho một yêu cầu: NO_SHALL, MULTI (shall xuất hiện >1 lần), VAGUE (từ mơ hồ trong danh sách, nguyên từ, không phân biệt hoa thường), PASSIVE ("shall be" + từ đuôi "ed"/"en"), TBD. Yêu cầu sạch trả []. Có kiểm trên dữ liệu ẩn.

Yêu cầu

  • So nguyên từ: "supported" không bị tính là "support"; "etc." thì có.

examplesJson.input: lint("The report shall be sent fast.")

hintsJson: So nguyên từ: kiểm ký tự trước/sau không phải chữ, số hay "-" (để "user-friendliness" không khớp "user-friendly").

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A tool can pre-check mechanical defects (missing or multiple "shall", vague words, passive voice, TBDs), which lets inspectors concentrate on correctness, completeness and feasibility — things only people can judge.
